about: Going back to look at what the change watch says has changed: that it is chosen over a place that has not (M5, criterion 5), that a change looked at is worth nothing until it changes again (criterion 6), and the refusals in between.

flat.comment: Six metres by three, mapped. Top right is a cupboard with its door shut: floor inside, wall all round, so nothing in it can be seen from anywhere the rover can stand. The rover is at (0.55, 1.45).

scenarios.name: an armchair gone from its place is looked at from where the rover stands
scenarios.why: A furniture-sized change two metres away, in view: the scan says something changed and only a look says what, and from here the camera can see the place without the rover moving.

scenarios.name: something new across the room is driven to and looked at
scenarios.why: Nearly five metres off, too far to see well from here: the rover goes to stand within the certified band of it, as it would for a thing it wanted to place better.

scenarios.name: a changed place outranks a place equally far that was confirmed lately
scenarios.why: M5's criterion 5. The armchair's old place and a thing placed to 0.12 m, both 2 m from the rover and both in view. The thing has nothing left to gain from another look; the change has everything.

scenarios.name: a changed place outranks a world-model record equally far that was seen lately
scenarios.why: M5's criterion 5 as autonomy plans since 2026-10-17, around the world model's records: one seen on twelve visits with a depth place 0.12 m wide, 2 m from the rover as the armchair's old place is. A look would narrow it little and land about half the time; the change has everything to gain.

scenarios.name: a change looked at since it was seen is worth nothing beside a record that is not
scenarios.why: M5's criterion 6 as autonomy plans since 2026-10-17: the change looked at is worth nothing until the place changes again, and the rover goes on to a world-model record with something to gain rather than being held by the formerly novel place.

scenarios.name: a change looked at since it was seen is worth nothing
scenarios.why: M5's criterion 6. The look was taken after the watch began seeing the change, so another would learn nothing until the place changes again, and the rover is not held by one formerly novel thing.

scenarios.name: a change looked at before it was seen again is news again
scenarios.why: The look came before the watch began seeing this change: whatever it showed was the place as it was, not as it is.

scenarios.name: a look at the same place for a change of the other kind does not count
scenarios.why: Something gone and something new are two changes even where they overlap; a look at one is not a look at the other.

scenarios.name: an attempt that took no look halves what the next is worth
scenarios.why: The drive failed or a person stopped it: worth trying again, for less.

scenarios.name: two attempts that took no look and the change waits to be reported anew
scenarios.why: A place the rover keeps failing to reach or see is not tried for the rest of the run on the same evidence.

scenarios.name: a change smaller than furniture is not offered
scenarios.why: Doors and the edges of things: M5 counts furniture-sized changes, and a rover that went to look at every small one would look at nothing else.

scenarios.name: a change in the shut cupboard is offered and refused
scenarios.why: Nowhere the rover can stand sees into it. Said in the record rather than left out, so it is not mistaken for a change nobody noticed.

scenarios.name: the same change a little along costs no switch
scenarios.why: A change's middle moves as the watch adds cells to it; going on with it is not changing its mind.

scenarios.name: a change of the other kind at the same place is a switch
scenarios.why: The goal it was on was a different change: leaving it costs what changing its mind costs.

scenarios.name: switched off, a change is recorded and not acted on
scenarios.why: A rover whose scoring.json switches the look off records what it would have done about the change, and does something else -- as every run did in shadow acceptance until 2026-10-12.

scenarios.name: the M0a protocol does not go and look at changes
scenarios.why: The frozen protocol runs hypothesis inspections and nothing else (R-AUT-12).
